meta.name: safari-pilot
meta.description: Native Safari browser automation for AI agents on macOS. Use when browsing websites, filling forms, extracting data, testing web apps, or any task involving web pages on Mac. Triggers on: "browse in Safari", "use Safari", "navigate to", "fill form", "extract from", "test this page", "check website", or any URL when on macOS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Safari 浏览器自动完成网页操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在 Mac 上通过 Safari 浏览器自动执行网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web tasks in Safari browser on macOS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate web tasks in Safari on Mac

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动控制 Mac 上的 Safari 浏览器，执行打开网页、填写表单、点击按钮、提取文字、截图等操作，并实时查看页面状态。
howto.when: 当你在 Mac 上提到“用 Safari 浏览”、“导航到某个网址”、“填写表单”、“提取数据”等指令，或直接给出一个网址时，Claude 会接管 Safari 来完成任务。

say.text: 用 Safari 打开百度，搜索今天的天气。
帮我填写这个登录表单，用户名是 admin，密码是 123456。
say.note: Claude 会定位表单字段并模拟输入。

say.text: 提取当前页面上所有链接。
say.note: Claude 会调用提取链接工具并返回列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can natively control Safari on macOS to open web pages, fill forms, click buttons, extract text, take screenshots, and verify page state in real time.
howto.when_en: When you mention "browse in Safari", "navigate to a URL", "fill form", "extract data", or provide a URL on macOS, Claude will take over Safari to perform the task.

say_en.text: Open Baidu in Safari and search for today's weather.
Fill in this login form with username admin and password 123456.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the form fields and simulate keystrokes.

say_en.text: Extract all links from the current page.
say_en.note: Claude will use the extract links tool and return the list.
